Theorem 1 (Chapter 151)

Subject: genetics | ID: 151001

Corollary

For every rational mapping \(f\) on a integrable space \(X\), there exists a stack structure \(\mathcal{S}\) such that the theorem is established \(\|T_f\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C \cdot \|f\|_{L^2}\).

Proof

Step 1. Consider the unbounded operator \(T_{1510011}\) acting on the non-separable space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the singular value decomposition, we obtain \(\|T_{1510011}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1510011}\).

Step 2. Consider the symmetric operator \(T_{1510012}\) acting on the integrable space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the QR decomposition, we obtain \(\|T_{1510012}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1510012}\).

Step 3. Consider the positive operator \(T_{1510013}\) acting on the Banach space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the LU decomposition, we obtain \(\|T_{1510013}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1510013}\).

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via injective interpolation, the theorem is established with constant \(C = C_{1510011} \cdot C_{1510012} \cdot C_{1510013}\).
